mission_08: Deduplication with multiple keys addresses the common scenario where records may be duplicates based on a combination of fields rather than exact row matches. This requires normalizing text fields (lowercasing, stripping whitespace) before comparison, then using sort_values() to order records by a priority column (like score or timestamp) before dropping duplicates. The key insight is that when duplicate records have different values in other columns, you need a strategy for which record to keep. Sorting by a quality metric and keeping the first occurrence ensures you retain the best version of each unique entity.
